meta.name: ESP32-S31 Korvo Board voice HA controller
meta.description: Voice-controlled wall dashboard for a Home Assistant setup that controls the TRV radiator valves of each room

features.text: Voice control — mic opens for one request when a front button is pressed (or the on-screen mic icon), listens ~10 s and closes again; no spoken replies, feedback on screen + LED
Wake word "Hi ESP" stays enabled as a fallback — saying it opens the same one-request listening window as the button
Spoken commands set a room's target: "set the office to 21", "living room twenty one and a half", "hallway plus one", "cancel"
Room thermostat dashboard — on-board RGB LCD shows the 4 rooms with current temperature (from the air sensors) and target (from each TRV's reported state)
Touch control — GT1151 touch panel selects a room and raises/lowers its target temperature, step 0.5 °C within the TRV's allowed range
Setpoints are published straight to the zigbee2mqtt TRV setpoint topics over MQTT (no Home Assistant automations involved); one fixed topic per room, configurable on the web page
Permit-join button — one tap publishes the zigbee2mqtt coordinator's permit_join request to pair a new TRV
Current room temperatures are read from the room air sensors' zigbee2mqtt topics (the device has no thermometer of its own)
Shows the 4 smart-heated rooms — bathroom, hallway, office, living room (kitchen and bedroom have no smart TRV and stay off the screen)
Local web page — SoftAP + mDNS onboarding, plus a settings page for the MQTT broker and the per-room TRV / air-sensor topics
Status LED (on-board WS2812 strip) — shows listening / thinking / speaking / offline
